cohort: 90 pregnant women at term admitted for delivery
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 experienced more frequent abnormal CTG patterns, particularly fetal tachycardia and reduced variability, compared to healthy controls, suggesting a link between maternal COVID-19 infection and fetal well-being during labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the COVID-19 group compared to controls, with abnormal fetal heart tracing being a significant contributing factor.
